proposed_widenings.name: on_zero_hp_window
proposed_widenings.justification: Disintegrate's disintegration effect is gated on 'if this damage reduces target to 0 HP' — a conditional window that fires only when a specific HP threshold is crossed by the spell's damage. No existing window atom covers this trigger. The closest is on_hit_window (fires on any hit) or post_roll_window (fires after roll resolution), but neither expresses the 0-HP threshold condition. This is structurally distinct from the save outcome: a creature can fail the save, take damage, survive, and NOT be disintegrated.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If this damage reduces it to 0 Hit Points, it and everything nonmagical it is wearing and carrying are disintegrated into gray dust.

proposed_widenings.name: apply_permanent_destruction
proposed_widenings.justification: The disintegration state is mechanically distinct from normal death: the body is destroyed (no corpse for Raise Dead/Resurrection), carried equipment is also destroyed, and only True Resurrection or Wish can revive the target. No existing v4 effect atom captures 'permanent destruction with restricted revival path'. apply_condition cannot cover this — 'disintegrated' is not a SRD condition. transport_exile is wrong (the creature isn't moved). A new effect atom is needed to represent the state of being reduced to gray dust.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The target can be revived only by a True Resurrection or a Wish spell.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase.auto_effect (or object_target attachment)
proposed_widenings.justification: Nonmagical objects and magical force constructs targeted by Disintegrate have no saving throw — the spell automatically disintegrates them (Large or smaller instantly; Huge+ yields a 10-ft Cube portion). The current ActivationPhase union only has attack_roll and save_gate kinds; neither can express 'no resolution step, automatic effect.' Object targeting also has no representation in the Attachment type for spells (target implies creature-like entities with saves and HP).
proposed_widenings.evidence: This spell automatically disintegrates a Large or smaller nonmagical object or a creation of magical force. If such a target is Huge or larger, this spell disintegrates a 10-foot-Cube portion of it.

notes: The spell's primary creature mechanic (DEX save gate → 10d6+40 Force damage with linear_per_level slot scaling at axis=slot, +3d6/slot above 6) fits the activation/save_gate family cleanly — the DiceAmount shape is fully expressible. Encoding was blocked because the on-0-HP disintegration is the defining mechanic of the spell: without it, the trace is indistinguishable from any other high-damage Force save spell, which would be misleading. The object-targeting auto-disintegrate (no save) is a secondary gap. Narrowest honest classification is atom_widening: both missing pieces (on_zero_hp_window trigger and apply_permanent_destruction effect) are absent from the v4 atom inventory, not merely missing surface variants of existing atoms.
